question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42651, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 handle narrower slices, or should maintainers narrow it to one specific config/API contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics, which requires product/API ownership rather than a small bug-fix decision.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until backend, role-slot, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Declare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and its PR as the canonical architecture work and narrow this issue to remaining backend/flush semantics.

options.title: Sponsor memory.type Design
options.body: Approve a smaller builtin-only, qmd-only, and mixed config design, accepting that it may not solve plugin role ownership or CRUD lifecycle by itself.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until backend, role-slot, flush, and operator-surface contracts converge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent memory/config/plugin-boundary history and is the best visible owner for a public product/API contract decision.
